citations.quote: Name: Pyke. Official role tags: Support, Assassin.
Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.
Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.

core_mechanics.summary: Pulls enemies and threatens executions that enable recasts and allied gold.

purpose: Recognize Pyke's identity and main fighting pattern.
title: Pyke

citations.quote: While Pyke is not visible to enemies, he rapidly consumes his grey health to heal for the same amount.
Innate: Pyke stores grey health when receiving damage from enemy champions, increased if there are multiple nearby.

core_mechanics.summary: Stores champion damage as grey health and heals from it outside enemy vision.

citations.quote: Pyke's maximum health cannot increase except through growth (per level), instead he gains「 1 bonus attack damage per 14 bonus health. 」「 bonus attack damage equal to 7.143% of bonus health. 」

core_mechanics.summary: Bonus health converts into AD; maximum health increases through leveling.

purpose: Understand why Pyke recovers after leaving vision.
title: Gift of the Drowned Ones

citations.quote: The pull can fling an enemy behind Pyke if the harpoon hits at close range.

advanced_exceptions.summary: A close-range harpoon can pull the target behind Pyke.

citations.quote: Releasing the ability within 0.4 seconds causes Pyke to instead thrust his blade in the target direction, dealing the same damage to the closest enemy champion, or closest enemy otherwise.

core_mechanics.summary: Quick release stabs and prioritizes a nearby champion.

citations.quote: Active: Pyke charges up to a short time, increasing the range of his harpoon.
Empowered Recast: Pyke hurls his harpoon in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit and pulls them towards him. The target is then briefly slowed.

core_mechanics.summary: Charged harpoon gains range and pulls and slows the first enemy hit.

purpose: Distinguish the quick stab from the charged catch.
title: Bone Skewer

citations.quote: PENDING FOR TEST: While submerged, a unique visual indicator will appear above Pyke if there are enemy champions closer than 700 units but farther than 600 units.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The additional indicator above Pyke is explicitly pending testing and is omitted.

citations.quote: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.

core_mechanics.summary: Camouflage with decaying bonus movement speed.

citations.quote: Enemy champions within 1500 units of Pyke are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with Death from Below.
Attacking or casting abilities ends Ghostwater Dive immediately.

core_mechanics.summary: Nearby enemies receive a warning; attacks and ability casts end the effect.

purpose: Recognize Pyke's approach tool and its warning.
title: Ghostwater Dive

citations.quote: Active: Pyke dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a phantom and becoming ghosted. After a brief period, the phantom homes back to Pyke to briefly stun enemies it passes through. Enemy champions hit also take physical damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Dash leaves a delayed returning phantom that stuns enemies and damages champions.

purpose: Recognize the delayed stun after his dash.
title: Phantom Undertow

citations.quote: If the target is in a zombie state, does not enter the death state, or is killed by the ability while above the execution threshold, Death from Below does not grant Your Cut nor the recast.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Special death states and kills above the execution threshold can deny the gold reward and recast.

citations.quote: Active: Pyke strikes the target location in a X pattern, which executes enemy champions hit that are at low health. Other enemies hit are instead dealt physical damage.

core_mechanics.summary: X-shaped strike executes low-health champions and otherwise deals physical damage.

citations.quote: If Death from Below hits an enemy champion or at least one is killed inside the X by the execution or an ally, Pyke will blink to the center of the X. For the latter case Pyke can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.
Each execution grants kill gold to both Pyke and the last assisting ally instead of the natural assist gold.

core_mechanics.summary: Champion hits enable a blink; deaths inside the strike enable a recast, and executions reward the assisting ally.

purpose: Recognize the execution area and continuing recast threat.
title: Death from Below
